name: GJH Chibi Visitor
summary: Primary Blender-built GJH Chibi Visitor with a static round-two wave pose, larger happy eyes, bolder GJH lettering, and a white hoodie.
description: The primary Blender-built GJH Chibi Visitor is a static, one-metre procedural character in a mild wave pose, with its anatomical left hand raised, a rounded white helmet, purple happy face screen, wing fins, headphones, white hoodie, and GJH chest lettering.
author: Original owner-project procedural model
creation_method: Deterministic procedural character geometry and materials generated with Blender from generate.py. The round-two default export is a static wave pose; the source also exports neutral standing and all-modules kit GLBs.
accuracy_notes: The private character-sheet image is not redistributed. The round-two default is a static, mildly leaned wave with the anatomical left hand raised and a stepping right leg; it is not a rigged or animated wave, and its perspective and asymmetry are milder than the illustration. Raised purple Bfont mesh lettering is larger and bolder but is not an exact trace of the illustrated chunky letters. The wider, thicker happy arcs and violet emission remain renderer-dependent, and bloom is not guaranteed. Helmet contours, visor shoulders, collar and fins remain regular geometric forms; the fins and collar are angular from side and rear views, physical screen reflections differ from painted highlights, and cloth folds, cuffs, shorts, shoes and the pocket seam are simplified interpretations. Inverted-hull outlines remain uniform rather than hand-drawn, and the PBR response is not cel shading. Expressions, outfits and accessories remain separate source/kit modules without gallery wardrobe switching or animated facial transitions. Exact fidelity to the private sheet remains unverified.

attribution.credit: Original procedural character geometry and materials generated with Blender 5.2.3 LTS for the owner’s project; no third-party model is included.
Blender-bundled Bfont creates the GJH chest lettering as mesh geometry; no external font file is included.

rights: Original asset; reuse in the owner's projects is authorized. Public redistribution terms have not been specified.
